profile.headline: Associate Early Careers Recruiter - JPMC | Passionate About Student Success & Community Building
profile.jobTitle: Early Careers Recruiter - Software Engineer Program
profile.summary: Solutions-oriented professional with 6+ years of experience in higher education, recruitment, retention, and building and maintaining relationships with students and stakeholders. Passionate about helping students achieve their full and authentic potential.

positions.title: Early Careers Recruiter - Software Engineer Program
positions.description: Early Careers Recruiter for the Software Engineer Program. I recruit for Tampa and lead the Code for Good and JPMC Fellowship recruiting initiatives.

positions.title: Director, Student Advising and Department Initiatives
positions.description:
•Academic advisor for 700+ computer science students (undergraduate and graduate level), tracking progress, retention, and program completion
•Charged with recruitment efforts for prospective students and their families, impacting university and department revenue and target numbers
•Coordinated and executed over four events event semester including industry visits, info sessions, department orientation for international students, networking fairs, etc.
•Managed one professional staff member and four students
•Organized and manage departmental data utilizing Google Apps 
•Over my tenure, I collaborated with stakeholders to establish internship, co-op, full-time, research, and project opportunities by 90%
•Managed social media accounts for the department (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn)
•Served as the liaison among stakeholders on and off campus

honors.title: Southern Ohio Region Champion
honors.description: This event is a leadership program that creates a dynamic leadership experience practice field that challenges you to test the boundaries of your knowledge and skills. It is similar to a 'field day' in that the CLC is a tangible, competitive experience that incorporates a series of puzzles, team building challenges, and action-orientated case studies that serve as an opportunity to practice leadership.
